statistical_contract.joint: independent Gaussian alpha1/alpha2/alphaexp as stated bysource; explicitly condition alpha1>alphaexp>alpha2>0. Positive absdelta only, no sign inference.
statistical_contract.full_pushforward: integrate exact delta=sqrt((alpha1-alphaexp)/(alphaexp-alpha2)) over physical domain; alphaexp -> delta includes abs Jacobian
statistical_contract.partial_Pi: one input varies while two fixed atsource central; conditional physical support retained; each partial normalized separately
statistical_contract.literal_convolution: ordinary independent sum convolution of positive Pi, no recentering shifts because printedEq14 specifies none; report only mathematical literal implication, not claim actual RooFit recipe recovered
statistical_contract.likelihood_comparison: fixed purealpha Gaussian likelihood in delta with flat delta coordinate, explicitly a different object and may be improper on0infinity
statistical_contract.interval_definition: author says34% probability each side of mean; compute that and equal-tailed16/84 separately, neither a frequentist coverage proof
statistical_contract.tails: derive d^-3 from alphaexp endpoint with nonzero density; first moment finite, second moment logarithmic divergent under chosenGaussian/domain model, not empirical heavy-tail data

numeric_design.MC_role: independent check of joint physical probability and quantiles; finite sample mean may be tail-unstable
numeric_design.quadrature: CDF analytic in alphaexp; GaussHermite over theory normals; theta=atan(delta) compact integration for mean

failure_controls: probability domain rejected explicitly not silently clamp
